name: Patient Administration System
summary: Hospital patient administration: admissions, appointments, waiting lists, referrals, reminders and patient notifications, with a patient portal and staff tools. Rust server (Axum, PostgreSQL), SvelteKit UI (Keycloak sign-in), Podman development stack. Pre-1.0, not production-ready and unaudited; it does not pass its own NHS DTAC self-assessment.
details: Behaviour is defined by the specification in spec/, and a change is spec + code + test together. Each requirement names the test that verifies it, or says "not yet tested". The REST API describes itself: a running server serves OpenAPI at /api-docs/openapi.json and Swagger UI at /swagger-ui/. Everything under governance/ is an unreviewed draft.
